## 09_Data_Store_Adapter (v1.1)
Input: `{ operation, data }` → Output: `{ success, operation, rows_count, rows, error? }`
Ops: get_user, insert_request, update_request, get_request(JOIN users), insert_slots, get_slots, get_slot, lock_slot(allow_retry), update_slot_status, find_event, insert_event(idempotent), update_event, delete_event, insert_reminder(idempotent), finalize_create, insert_weather_logs, get_habit_hours, log_session.
Datetime: chuỗi `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).
